name: x402bench-agentic-payments
description: Benchmark suite for agentic pay-per-request commerce with Hedera, Chainlink CRE, and Ledger policy controls.

scripts.readiness:bench: node scripts/run_llm_readiness_benchmark.mjs --config config/benchmark.config.json --suite readiness_bench/suite.json --runtime ollama --models gemma4:e4b,qwen3:4b-instruct,phi4:14b,qwen2.5:0.5b --outdir readiness_bench/results
scripts.readiness:bench:hf: node scripts/run_llm_readiness_benchmark.mjs --config config/benchmark.config.json --suite readiness_bench/suite.json --runtime openai_compat --api-base-url https://router.huggingface.co/v1 --api-key-env HF_TOKEN --models Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct,google/gemma-3-4b-it --outdir readiness_bench/results
